parsed_json.up_exec: Return distinct IC50 activity records (in nM) for the human single-protein target Amine oxidase [flavin-containing] A (CHEMBL1951). For each qualifying activity row, include the compound ChEMBL ID, canonical SMILES, compound key, PubMed ID or DOI (prefer PubMed), assay description, standard type, relation, value, units, activity comment, target ChEMBL ID, target name, and target organism. Only include rows where canonical SMILES is available and the document has a PubMed ID or DOI.
